correction.text: The Maldives from 1153: the chain of atolls ruled from Male (one cell on the land grid; the atolls south of the equator, including Addu and the Gan base, have no land cell)

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: the country shape of the Maldives. The page gives no area; the Natural Earth country resolves to one 253 km2 cell at Male.

region.text: the Maldives: the atolls ruled from Male

ledger.note: 1153: the Maldivian Sultanate begins. 'The last Buddhist king converted to Islam in the year 1153' and the sultanate 'controlled the Maldives for over eight centuries (1153-1968)'; the infobox gives 1153 as the start. The land is the whole chain; on the land grid it is a single cell round Male.

region.text: Male, where the Portuguese garrison stood

ledger.note: 1558: 'a Portuguese garrison was established on Male' (the Portuguese had arrived in the Maldives in 1507).

region.text: Male, where the Portuguese garrison stood

ledger.note: 1573: 'a popular revolt led by Muhammad Thakurufaanu al-Auzam drove the Portuguese away.'
1953: 'a third constitution was created in 1953', which dissolved the sultanate in favour of a presidential republic; the page gives no month. The state, its land and its capital continue.
1954: the referendum 'resulted in the restoration of the Sultanate in 1954'.

1968: the final referendum 'resulted in the establishment of a presidential republic, putting an end to the 815-year-old sultanate'; the page gives no day or month. On 21 January 1969 the state declared its name 'Republic of Maldives'. The state continues under the same slug to 2024.

certainty.note: A scatter of atolls; the grid resolves the whole country to one cell, so only the dates carry information.

sources.title: Maldivian Sultanate
sources.note: Infobox 1153-1968; Islam 1153; Portuguese garrison on Male 1558, driven out 1573; British protectorate confirmed 1887; republic 1953, sultanate restored 1954; Suvadive Republic 1959-1963; independence 26 July 1965; republic 1968.

notes:
Written 2026-10-25 by sa-06-x. A state Cliopatria lacks (and no sibling part owns): cliopatria_names empty, one new keyframe. One page opened (Maldivian Sultanate); WebFetch returned an extract. The dossier runs 1153-2024 as one state: the sultanate, the first republic of 1953-1954, the restored sultanate and the republic of 1968 are renames, not new states, because the land, the capital and the colour continue. Nothing in the other sa-06 parts covers the Maldives.

The map can show little: the land grid is 253 km2 cells of land and the Natural Earth country resolves to a single cell at Male; the atolls south of the equator (Addu with the Gan base, Huvadhu, Fuvahmulah) have no land cell, so the United Suvadive Republic (1 January 1959 to 1963, 'reannexed into the Maldives in 1963' on the page) cannot be drawn as a loss and a gain and is left out of the ledger. The page gives no area.

Page silent: the day and month of the 1968 abolition (11 November 1968 is not on the page), the year of RAF Gan (World War II) and of the 100-year lease of Gan, the year of the Dutch protection ('in the mid-seventeenth century the Dutch would govern the Maldives' from Dutch Ceylon; 1645 is not on the page), the first constitution of 1932 (no land), any area, and any war after independence.

Suzerainty events kept out of the ledger: vassal_start and vassal_end belong in the suzerain's dossier with this state as the counterpart (the schema: 'counterpart is the vassal itself'), so they are listed here for whoever writes or checks the suzerain. 1887 vassal_start (suzerain british-empire, confidence 3, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maldivian_Sultanate): 1887: 'The status of the Maldivan sultanate as a British protectorate was confirmed in an 1887 agreement.' | 1965-07 vassal_end (suzerain british-empire, confidence 3, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maldivian_Sultanate): 26 July 1965: 'the Maldives achieved independence through an agreement' with the United Kingdom.
